title: CmdPal: Add IFormContent2 support
summary: The member-authored PR passed the process-context review and its five-file scope was mirrored exactly to fork PR 491. Three valid Copilot findings were fixed across the fork review loop: AdaptiveExecuteAction data forwarding, direct IFormContent2 dispatch and legacy fallback coverage, and direct coverage of the default SubmitAction-to-SubmitForm compatibility forwarding path. Builds and targeted tests pass, all review threads are resolved at fork head 874c33f0805b10caf4ce94996660f18a7a696549, but a fresh Copilot review could not be assigned at that head.

test_instructions: Open the Sample Pages extension and navigate to Sample Content.
Submit the primary form action and the nested comment action; verify each toast reports its distinct action ID.
Exercise an Adaptive Execute action carrying data and verify the IFormContent2 handler receives both the action ID and the action data.
